annotations.title: Coupon and redemption plan for a portfolio

description: Cash flow plan for bonds the user holds: give series codes with the face value held and get coupons and redemptions month by month for up to 120 months, before and after the 19% tax (or another rate, e.g. 0 for IKE/IKZE), totals per currency and each payment. Floating coupons after the current period assume the current rate stays. Nothing is stored. Plan wpływów z obligacji: kupony i wykupy miesiąc po miesiącu.

holdings.description: Up to 20 positions separated by commas: "CODE:FACE_VALUE_HELD" or "CODE:QUANTITY@FACE_VALUE_OF_ONE_BOND", e.g. "KRU0632:10000, ECO1028:5@1000". Ask the user for the face value of one bond if unsure (often 100 or 1000).

tax_pct.description: Tax on interest in % (default 19, the Polish flat tax; 0 for IKE/IKZE).

name: portfolio_cashflows
